data.one_liner: Flutter SDK for real‑time chat, video calling and push notifications via ConnectyCube.
data.what_it_does: Provides client APIs to authenticate users, send and receive messages, make video calls and handle push notifications using the ConnectyCube backend. Works across Android, iOS, Web, macOS, Windows and Linux.
use_when: You need cross‑platform real‑time chat or video calling without building your own server
You want a single SDK that covers auth, messaging, calling and push notifications
avoid_when: You require a fully self‑hosted backend or deep native customization
You already use Firebase services for auth, messaging or notifications
strengths: All‑in‑one solution for chat, calls and notifications
Cross‑platform support including desktop and web
Simplified auth flow with no server‑side code
weaknesses: Tied to ConnectyCube service, limiting flexibility
Limited community support compared to larger ecosystems
May require additional native permissions for camera/mic
data.setup_notes: Add ConnectyCube credentials (appId, authKey) and call init(); configure CubeSettings; add platform permissions for camera, microphone and internet; no build_runner needed

alternatives.name: firebase_messaging
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you already use Firebase for push notifications and prefer Google’s ecosystem

alternatives.name: intercom_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: For in‑app chat with a SaaS solution that includes rich UI and analytics

alternatives.name: onesignal_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: For push notifications without needing ConnectyCube’s backend
